Record notes

Focused survey strategy, question design, sampling, logic, accessibility/privacy, pilot QA, exports and analysis/codebooks. 8 retained skill heads. One restricted supplied QuestionTypes.txt archive excluded; all original procedure/helper content retained.

Version 0.1.3 includes 8 complete skill procedures. Complete original methods and helpers; restricted supplied question-type archive excluded.

Requirements: Host file tools; Python for validation and export helpers.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add survey-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from fa4f68d5883a99971983ed9a7d874bc6e8993ec6. SHA-256: 15b58ff1abc2420660a62dd84472be8f5e62078503e24eaccf5b33ac342402c8.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
